type: ({ agentPresentation, title, agent, status, steps, elapsed, outputs, autoStartAfter, onStart, onEditPlan, onSteer, onApplyNoteNow, onRemoveNote, onStop, onDecision, onRetryStep, onSkipStep, onReconnect, primaryAction, headingLevel, labels, announcement, appearance, }: AgentTaskProps) => JSX.Element
description:
Agent task (spec §12.3): a multi-step job the agent runs while the person
stays in control. The host owns the status, the steps and the time; the
pattern names the state once, announces each status once, and reports
what the person asks for: start, steer, stop, decide, retry or skip.

parameters.name:
{
  agentPresentation,
  title,
  agent,
  status,
  steps,
  elapsed,
  outputs,
  autoStartAfter,
  onStart,
  onEditPlan,
  onSteer,
  onApplyNoteNow,
  onRemoveNote,
  onStop,
  onDecision,
  onRetryStep,
  onSkipStep,
  onReconnect,
  primaryAction,
  headingLevel = 3,
  labels,
  announcement = "polite",
  appearance = "card",
}

agentPresentation.description: Optional avatar, name, identity controls and tray color in the existing header.

announcement.description: Speak status and steering feedback politely, or leave announcements to the host.

appearance.description: "card" sits on a tray; "plain" lives on its host's paper.

autoStartAfter.description: Seconds before a proposed plan starts on its own; it calls `onStart`.

elapsed.description: Seconds, shown in the pill while running and once done; never announced.

headingLevel.description: The title's level; 3 by default. Nested headings sit one deeper.

onApplyNoteNow.description: A queued note's Apply now and Remove while running, each only when given.

onDecision.type: ((request: ApprovalRequest, decision: ApprovalDecision, context: { signal: AbortSignal; }) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined
onDecision.description: The inline approval's (request, decision, { signal }) contract.

outputs.type: readonly { id: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; onOpen?(): void; }[] | undefined
